name: B10-0200/2024 (ECR) – Reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on reinforcing EU’s unwavering support to Ukraine against Russia’s war of aggression and the increasing military cooperation between North Korea and Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for stronger military and financial support for Ukraine against Russia's war. It asks for more long-range weapons, air defence systems and ammunition, without limits on how Ukraine uses them. It wants tougher sanctions on Russia and on countries helping it, including North Korea and Iran. It also demands that Russia pay for the damage it caused and that its leaders face international justice. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to send Ukraine more weapons and tighten sanctions; EU governments decide whether to act.
- It affects Ukraine, Russia, North Korea, Iran and EU countries supplying weapons or buying Russian fuel.
- Next, the resolution goes to EU governments, the European Commission and other named bodies for their response.
